quizzes.question_text: Which sign makes this statement true?\n\n38 ___ 48
quizzes.question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
solution: To compare two integers and pick the correct sign, think of where each one sits on a number line. $$\\[1em]$$ Anything to the right of another number is greater $(>)$; anything to the left is less $(<)$; only equal numbers use $(=)$. $$\\[1em]$$ We need to compare $38$ and $48$.
Both numbers are zero or positive. The bigger value sits farther to the right of zero. $$\\[1em]$$ Comparing directly: $38 < 48$.
The correct sign is $<$, making the statement $38 < 48$ true. $$\\[1em]$$ That is choice B.

quizzes.question_text: Which sign makes this statement true?\n\n45 ___ -10
quizzes.question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
solution: To compare two integers and pick the correct sign, think of where each one sits on a number line. $$\\[1em]$$ Anything to the right of another number is greater $(>)$; anything to the left is less $(<)$; only equal numbers use $(=)$. $$\\[1em]$$ We need to compare $45$ and $-10$.

One number is negative and the other is non-negative. Any negative number is to the left of zero, and any non-negative number is at or to the right of zero. $$\\[1em]$$ So the non-negative one is greater: $45 > -10$.
The correct sign is $>$, making the statement $45 > -10$ true. $$\\[1em]$$ That is choice A.

quizzes.question_text: Which sign makes this statement true?\n\n-3 ___ -37
quizzes.question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
solution: To compare two integers and pick the correct sign, think of where each one sits on a number line. $$\\[1em]$$ Anything to the right of another number is greater $(>)$; anything to the left is less $(<)$; only equal numbers use $(=)$. $$\\[1em]$$ We need to compare $-3$ and $-37$.
Both numbers are negative. With negatives, the one with the larger absolute value is actually smaller (it sits farther to the left of zero). $$\\[1em]$$ $|-3| = 3$ and $|-37| = 37$. So $-3 > -37$.
The correct sign is $>$, making the statement $-3 > -37$ true. $$\\[1em]$$ That is choice A.

The correct sign is $<$, making the statement $-7 < 2$ true. $$\\[1em]$$ That is choice B.
